title: Read-only delegated reviewer can see a falsely clean worktree
outcome: During /review-changes wait delegation-wait-177c68f2-a654-4e0f-a611-cc0fd0937d70, the concurrently spawned read-only Codex reviewer session-4661 ran git status/diff in /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/termal and reported no staged, unstaged, or untracked changes, while Claude session-4660 saw the expected ~40-file shared worktree and reviewed it. This makes a nominally completed two-reviewer fan-in incomplete and can falsely report a clean review.
acceptance: Concurrent Codex and Claude read-only review sessions spawned against the same dirty shared worktree observe the same HEAD/index/worktree/untracked identity; a mismatch fails explicitly instead of returning a clean review; regression coverage reproduces the shared-worktree reviewer launch path.
Focused verification and the maintained full gate pass on the final input, and independent reviews find no unresolved in-scope Medium or higher.
